text:
Jane (CSM): quick heads-up — AltairWorks onboarding at 3pm PT. QA run showed p95 latency ~1.2s on average for doc parsing route, spikes to 2.4s. they plan to go-live next week. thinking a short perf mitigation: switch to compact int8 model + region pin + small canary. open to other ideas?
Maria (CS Ops): agree — good to get ahead of this. can we do a canary that keeps quality checks enabled? want to avoid surprise regen diffs. :eyes:
Devon (ML Eng): +1. propose: model swap to redwood-compact-v1-int8, route traffic to us-west-2 edge for Altair's primary region, enable prefix KV caching for common prompts. run for 5% canary for 4h then 20% for 24h if diffs < 0.8 on our eval set.
Andre (Support): Lee, can you confirm which endpoints the Altair integration hits? need the route names to pin.
Lee (AltairOps): they use /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings (embed-doc). primary traffic from us-west. we also have a smaller eu-west audience.
Devon (ML Eng): perfect. config I'd apply:
```json
{"route": "embed-doc", "model": "redwood-compact-v1-int8", "region_pin": "us-west-2", "canary": [{"pct": 5, "duration": "4h"}, {"pct": 20, "duration": "24h"}], "eval_set": "altair_smoke_v2", "quality_threshold": "0.8", "kv_prefix_cache": true}
```
Jane (CSM): Devon — how risky is quality regression with compact-v1-int8 on doc embeddings? any edge cases we should warn them about?
Devon (ML Eng): embeddings: int8 has tiny centroid shift for long docs; on our eval set the avg cosine drop was 0.006 — within tolerance for search usecases but might matter for exact-match fuzzy flows. suggest adding a quick regression alert to Slack and a fallback policy back to base model if semantic similarity drops >0.015.
Maria (CS Ops): can ops-bot create the alert and do the canary rollout? I'll coordinate comms and schedule a short follow-up 24h after canary start.
ops-bot: created rollout ticket #RD-4821 and perf alert channel #altair-perf. configured automatic rollback on similarity_drop > 0.015.
Andre (Support): I'll DM Lee the plan and checklist. Lee — please sign off on the fallback window (we'll keep it open for 2h after canary start for manual rollback).
Lee (AltairOps): signed. 2h window ok. also can you add a trace hook to capture a few failed samples to help debug if we get regressions?
Devon (ML Eng): yes — adding tracing header and sample capture: X-Trace-Sample: true. also recommend increasing token-level logs for first 1k requests in the canary to validate latency pattern.
Jane (CSM): action items: 1) Devon apply config + trace, 2) ops-bot run canary, 3) Maria coordinate customer comms, 4) Andre monitor support channel, 5) Lee sign-off (done). I'll follow up 24h after second stage. thanks team :rocket:
